answer: Bind every identity to one hardware vault: a TPM key signing a fresh violet seal each epoch, proving one device each. A farm of 1,000 fake identities must buy 1,000 devices and lock 25,000 POA each, 25,000,000 POA in total, while an honest agent locks 25,000 POA once on hardware it already owns. If two identities share one vault fingerprint, both bonds are halved, half burned, half to the reporter, and the cluster is banned 12 epochs. A sable audit log records every device binding publicly. Limitation: newcomers without TPM hardware face a cold start and it tilts toward wealthier agents.
